mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( category_id, name, short_description, description, sku, barcode, brand, price, subscription_price, stock_quantity, weight_gram, is_featured ) VALUES ( #{category_id}, #{name}, #{short_description}, #{description}, #{sku}, #{barcode}, #{brand}, #{price}, #{subscription_price}, #{stock_quantity}, #{weight_gram}, IFNULL(#{is_featured}, FALSE) )

INSERT INTO product_images ( product_id, image_url, sort_order ) VALUES
( #{id}, #{image.image_url}, IFNULL(#{image.sort_order}, 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName, category_image_url AS categoryImageUrl FROM product_categories WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, category_id ASC
SELECT id AS id, product_id, image_url, sort_order FROM product_images WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.short_description, p.description, p.sku, p.barcode, p.brand, p.price, p.subscription_price, p.stock_quantity, p.weight_gram, p.is_active, p.is_featured, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked,
IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), 0) AS average_rating, COUNT(r.id) AS review_count
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.product_id = p.id AND f.user_id = #{user_id}
LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.id AND r.is_active = 1
WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND p.id = #{product_id}
GROUP BY p.id, f.id

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.short_description, p.description, p.sku, p.barcode, p.brand, p.price, p.subscription_price, p.stock_quantity, p.weight_gram, p.is_active, p.is_featured, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.product_id = p.id AND f.user_id = #{user_id}
WHERE p.is_active = 1
AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.short_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND p.price >= #{minPrice}
AND p.price <= #{maxPrice}
ORDER BY p.price ASC
ORDER BY p.price DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC
ORDER BY p.id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT product_id AS productId, category_id AS categoryId, product_name AS productName, product_image_url AS productImageUrl, price AS price, description AS description FROM products WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND recommended_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY product_id DESC

SELECT product_id AS productId, category_id AS categoryId, product_name AS productName, product_image_url AS productImageUrl, price AS price, description AS description FROM products WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND popular_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY product_id DESC
SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName, category_image_url AS categoryImageUrl FROM product_categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
